import Pkg
haskey(Pkg.project().dependencies, "CUDA") || Pkg.add("CUDA")
using CUDA
using LinearAlgebra
CUDA.allowscalar(false)

using JSON3

function initstacks_cellscatter_b(i_ncell, i_njac, i_nnode)
    up_stack = Vector{Float64}(undef, (div(i_njac - 1, 1) + 1) * (div(i_nnode - 1, 1) + 1))
    auxu_stack = Vector{Float64}(undef, ((div(i_njac - 1, 1) + 1) * (div(i_ncell - 1, 1) + 1) + (div(i_njac - 1, 1) + 1)) + 1)
    return (up_stack, auxu_stack)
end

function cellscatter_b(i_cell_to_node, cell_vol, cell_volb, i_ncell, i_nnode, i_njac, up, upb, mup, mupb, up_stack, auxu_stack)
    auxu = 0.0
    auxub = 0.0
    for i_ = 1:i_njac
        for i_cell = 1:i_ncell
            auxu = 0.0
            for i_loc = 1:4
                i_lnode = i_cell_to_node[i_loc, i_cell]
                auxu = auxu + up[i_lnode]
            end
            for i_loc = 1:4
                i_lnode = i_cell_to_node[i_loc, i_cell]
                mup[i_lnode] = mup[i_lnode] + (auxu + up[i_lnode]) * cell_vol[i_cell]
            end
            auxu_stack[((i_ - 1) * (div(i_ncell - 1, 1) + 1) + (i_cell - 1)) + 1] = auxu
        end
        for i_node = 1:i_nnode
            up_stack[((i_ - 1) * (div(i_nnode - 1, 1) + 1) + (i_node - 1)) + 1] = up[i_node]
            up[i_node] = up[i_node] - mup[i_node]
        end
        auxu_stack[(div(i_njac - 1, 1) + 1) * (div(i_ncell - 1, 1) + 1) + ((i_ - 1) + 1)] = auxu
    end
    auxu_stack[((div(i_njac - 1, 1) + 1) * (div(i_ncell - 1, 1) + 1) + (div(i_njac - 1, 1) + 1)) + 1] = auxu
    auxu = auxu_stack[((div(i_njac - 1, 1) + 1) * (div(i_ncell - 1, 1) + 1) + (div(i_njac - 1, 1) + 1)) + 1]
    for i_ = i_njac:-1:1
        auxu = auxu_stack[(div(i_njac - 1, 1) + 1) * (div(i_ncell - 1, 1) + 1) + ((i_ - 1) + 1)]
        for i_node = i_nnode:-1:1
            up[i_node] = up_stack[((i_ - 1) * (div(i_nnode - 1, 1) + 1) + (i_node - 1)) + 1]
            mupb[i_node] = mupb[i_node] + -(upb[i_node])
        end
        for i_cell = i_ncell:-1:1
            auxu = auxu_stack[((i_ - 1) * (div(i_ncell - 1, 1) + 1) + (i_cell - 1)) + 1]
            for i_loc = 4:-1:1
                i_lnode = i_cell_to_node[i_loc, i_cell]
                auxub = auxub + cell_vol[i_cell] * mupb[i_lnode]
                upb[i_lnode] = upb[i_lnode] + cell_vol[i_cell] * mupb[i_lnode]
                cell_volb[i_cell] = cell_volb[i_cell] + (auxu + up[i_lnode]) * mupb[i_lnode]
            end
            for i_loc = 1:4
                i_lnode = i_cell_to_node[i_loc, i_cell]
                auxu = auxu + up[i_lnode]
                i_lnode = i_cell_to_node[i_loc, i_cell]
                upb[i_lnode] = upb[i_lnode] + auxub
            end
            auxub = 0.0
        end
    end
    return nothing
end

function initstacks_cellscatter_b_cuda(i_ncell, i_njac, i_nnode)
    up_stack = CuArray{Float64}(undef, (div(i_njac - 1, 1) + 1) * (div(i_nnode - 1, 1) + 1))
    auxu_stack = CuArray{Float64}(undef, ((div(i_njac - 1, 1) + 1) * (div(i_ncell - 1, 1) + 1) + (div(i_njac - 1, 1) + 1)) + 1)
    return (up_stack, auxu_stack)
end

function cellscatter_b_cuda(i_cell_to_node, cell_vol, cell_volb, i_ncell, i_nnode, i_njac, up, upb, mup, mupb, up_stack, auxu_stack)
    nthread_per_block = 256
    auxu = 0.0
    auxub = 0.0
    for i_ = 1:i_njac
        @cuda threads = nthread_per_block blocks = max(1, cld(div(i_ncell - 1, 1) + 1, nthread_per_block)) cuda_kernel_cellscatter_b_1!(auxu_stack, cell_vol, i_, i_cell_to_node, i_ncell, mup, up)
        @cuda threads = nthread_per_block blocks = max(1, cld(div(i_nnode - 1, 1) + 1, nthread_per_block)) cuda_kernel_cellscatter_b_2!(i_, i_nnode, mup, up, up_stack)
        CUDA.@allowscalar begin
                auxu_stack[(div(i_njac - 1, 1) + 1) * (div(i_ncell - 1, 1) + 1) + ((i_ - 1) + 1)] = auxu
            end
    end
    CUDA.@allowscalar begin
            auxu_stack[((div(i_njac - 1, 1) + 1) * (div(i_ncell - 1, 1) + 1) + (div(i_njac - 1, 1) + 1)) + 1] = auxu
            auxu = auxu_stack[((div(i_njac - 1, 1) + 1) * (div(i_ncell - 1, 1) + 1) + (div(i_njac - 1, 1) + 1)) + 1]
        end
    for i_ = i_njac:-1:1
        CUDA.@allowscalar begin
                auxu = auxu_stack[(div(i_njac - 1, 1) + 1) * (div(i_ncell - 1, 1) + 1) + ((i_ - 1) + 1)]
            end
        @cuda threads = nthread_per_block blocks = max(1, cld(div(1 - i_nnode, -1) + 1, nthread_per_block)) cuda_kernel_cellscatter_b_3!(i_, i_nnode, mupb, up, up_stack, upb)
        @cuda threads = nthread_per_block blocks = max(1, cld(div(1 - i_ncell, -1) + 1, nthread_per_block)) cuda_kernel_cellscatter_b_4!(auxu_stack, cell_vol, cell_volb, i_, i_cell_to_node, i_ncell, mupb, up, upb)
    end
    return nothing
end

function cuda_kernel_cellscatter_b_1!(auxu_stack, cell_vol, i_, i_cell_to_node, i_ncell, mup, up)
    __tid = ((blockIdx()).x - 1) * (blockDim()).x + (threadIdx()).x
    if __tid > div(i_ncell - 1, 1) + 1
        return nothing
    end
    i_cell = 1 + (__tid - 1)
    auxu = 0.0
    for i_loc = 1:4
        i_lnode = i_cell_to_node[i_loc, i_cell]
        auxu = auxu + up[i_lnode]
    end
    for i_loc = 1:4
        i_lnode = i_cell_to_node[i_loc, i_cell]
        CUDA.@atomic mup[i_lnode] += (auxu + up[i_lnode]) * cell_vol[i_cell]
    end
    auxu_stack[((i_ - 1) * (div(i_ncell - 1, 1) + 1) + (i_cell - 1)) + 1] = auxu
    return nothing
end

function cuda_kernel_cellscatter_b_2!(i_, i_nnode, mup, up, up_stack)
    __tid = ((blockIdx()).x - 1) * (blockDim()).x + (threadIdx()).x
    if __tid > div(i_nnode - 1, 1) + 1
        return nothing
    end
    i_node = 1 + (__tid - 1)
    up_stack[((i_ - 1) * (div(i_nnode - 1, 1) + 1) + (i_node - 1)) + 1] = up[i_node]
    up[i_node] = up[i_node] - mup[i_node]
    return nothing
end

function cuda_kernel_cellscatter_b_3!(i_, i_nnode, mupb, up, up_stack, upb)
    __tid = ((blockIdx()).x - 1) * (blockDim()).x + (threadIdx()).x
    if __tid > div(1 - i_nnode, -1) + 1
        return nothing
    end
    i_node = i_nnode + (__tid - 1) * -1
    up[i_node] = up_stack[((i_ - 1) * (div(i_nnode - 1, 1) + 1) + (i_node - 1)) + 1]
    mupb[i_node] = mupb[i_node] + -(upb[i_node])
    return nothing
end

function cuda_kernel_cellscatter_b_4!(auxu_stack, cell_vol, cell_volb, i_, i_cell_to_node, i_ncell, mupb, up, upb)
    __tid = ((blockIdx()).x - 1) * (blockDim()).x + (threadIdx()).x
    if __tid > div(1 - i_ncell, -1) + 1
        return nothing
    end
    i_cell = i_ncell + (__tid - 1) * -1
    auxub = 0.0
    auxu = auxu_stack[((i_ - 1) * (div(i_ncell - 1, 1) + 1) + (i_cell - 1)) + 1]
    for i_loc = 4:-1:1
        i_lnode = i_cell_to_node[i_loc, i_cell]
        auxub = auxub + cell_vol[i_cell] * mupb[i_lnode]
        CUDA.@atomic upb[i_lnode] += cell_vol[i_cell] * mupb[i_lnode]
        cell_volb[i_cell] = cell_volb[i_cell] + (auxu + up[i_lnode]) * mupb[i_lnode]
    end
    for i_loc = 1:4
        i_lnode = i_cell_to_node[i_loc, i_cell]
        auxu = auxu + up[i_lnode]
        i_lnode = i_cell_to_node[i_loc, i_cell]
        CUDA.@atomic upb[i_lnode] += auxub
    end
    auxub = 0.0
    return nothing
end

function _val_init_stacks_local(fn, extra_args)
    r = fn(extra_args...)
    r === nothing && return ()
    r isa Tuple && return r
    return (r,)
end
